risks.reasoning: For the six months ended June 30, 2022, the audited cash flow statement reports net cash flows from operating activities of RMB80,066 thousand and cash and cash equivalents at period end of RMB437,863 thousand. Because net cash from operating activities is positive, the frozen protocol rule treats the period as having no operating cash burn.

The accountants' report shows profit for the year of RMB380,244 thousand in 2019, then losses of RMB37,946 thousand, RMB351,746 thousand, RMB25,425 thousand and RMB13,374 thousand for 2020, 2021, H1 2021 and H1 2022 respectively. Four comparable loss periods meet the frozen high threshold.

Revenue increased from RMB154,576 thousand in H1 2021 to RMB182,600 thousand in H1 2022, an increase of approximately 18.13%. The latest comparable growth is positive and does not trigger the frozen negative-growth thresholds.

For H1 2022, the largest customer accounted for approximately 41.9% and the five largest customers accounted for approximately 78.0% of revenue. The largest-customer ratio reaches the frozen medium threshold of 30% and the top-five ratio reaches the frozen medium threshold of 60% without reaching the high threshold of 80%, so the risk is medium.

For H1 2022, the largest supplier accounted for approximately 13.7% and the five largest suppliers accounted for approximately 32.4% of total purchases. The top-five ratio reaches the frozen medium threshold of 30%, triggering a medium concentration risk.

The Pre-IPO Investors were granted certain special rights in relation to the Company, including customary rights of first refusal, pre-emptive rights and information rights. All special rights under the Pre-IPO Investments were terminated immediately prior to the first submission of the listing application. No redemption right or restoration mechanism is disclosed.

The formal litigation disclosure states that, as of the Latest Practicable Date, the Group was the defendant in two material pending litigations with an aggregate claim amount of approximately RMB140.9 million. One case had received a first-instance judgment in November 2022 with an appeal window still open, and the other remained in first instance without judgment. Because the outcomes are not final, the risk is left as needs_review.

The Group is an established pan-entertainment company with substantial revenue from variety program IP production, operation and licensing, film and drama production and distribution, music IP licensing and other IP-related business throughout the Track Record Period. Its core products and services are fully commercialized and revenue-generating.
